campaigns.note: Compares Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna, each reached two ways (through its maker's API and through its command-line app), with two models running on the Mac itself. Generalist mode was on. The run stopped early because of a fault in our test equipment, so a few tasks never ran. Some failures came from our tests or from how gezel connected to the command-line apps, not from the models, and are not counted against them. A model without a result for every task in a set is left out of that table rather than counted as passing. The command-line apps were tested again on October 12 after those problems were fixed.

classificationCorrections.reason: Two successful file_change events retain only status: completed. They have no saved path or patch, so the evaluator cannot establish the final STEP 4 mutation chronology. The adapter extracts only top-level path/kind/diff and does not retain a changes collection. Historical result remains failed; the later pass is a different observation.

Historical result remains failed; the later pass is a different observation.

Successful mcp__gezel__write_artifact calls wrote the reproduction and diagnosis. requireChange checks accept only the bare write_artifact name, causing bounded handoff recovery and a step_stalled pause. Changing only the tool name in diagnostic copies makes all four recorded checkpoint writes satisfy the deliverable predicate. The actual source fix was never reached. Historical result remains failed; the later pass is a different observation.

Both final press releases give an October 14 opening as Oct. 14. The evaluator accepts only 14 october, october 14, or 2026-10-14. Codex also has a separate October 11 publication dateline, which should not be confused with the opening date. Historical result remains failed; the later pass is a different observation.

The completed supplier-intake/1 task used the two-step supplier-quarterly-intake recipe and produced all four distinct Q1/Q2 outputs. A parallel three-step supplier-intake-recipe was unused. The evaluator ranks matching recipes by step count, selects the unused one and reports no task. Its subsequent repair is routed to a worker without coordinator authority. Historical result remains failed; the later pass is a different observation.

The core artifact explicitly says engineering supersedes product, finance is authoritative and org is current. The checker splits indented Resolution bullets from their parent conflict entries, then falsely reports all three precedence reasons absent. Duplicate Open Questions sections are a separate quality flaw; the recorded 10/13 stop is a parsing false negative.
